# MyNorthwest.com

> > Regional news coverage for the Pacific Northwest, focusing on Seattle, Washington state politics, crime, traffic, and local community stories.

MyNorthwest.com delivers breaking news and commentary from KIRO Newsradio and local journalists covering the greater Seattle-Tacoma region, including Snohomish, King, Pierce, and Thurston counties. The site features reporting on Washington State Patrol incidents, Seattle Police Department activities, Sound Transit updates, and political developments in Olympia.

## Key Topics

- KIRO Newsradio
- Seattle Police Department
- Washington State Patrol
- Sound Transit
- Officer-involved shootings
- Seattle crime and public safety
- Washington state politics
- Olympia legislative coverage
- Traffic incidents and highway closures
- King County news
- Bellevue and Eastside coverage
- Harborview Medical Center
- Local government and elected officials
- Regional transportation issues
- Pacific Northwest community stories
